candidates.description: This vector represents words related to separation, scattering, and spreading out.
These tokens represent common French adverbial modifiers of time, degree, and logical relation.
This vector represents French grammatical articles, pronouns, and contracted prepositions involving apostrophes.
This vector represents the concept of distinctiveness, discernment, and noticeable qualities.
This feature vector represents French singular indefinite and demonstrative determiners or articles.
This vector represents French modal and auxiliary verbs indicating tense, possibility, or necessity.
This vector activates on French interrogative and relative pronouns, particularly "qu-" words and related question markers.
This vector activates for adjectives, suffixes, and words related to capability, visibility, or state of being.
This vector represents the character sequence 'um' or words containing the letter combination 'um'.
This vector represents linguistic roots, suffixes, and genealogical terms related to descendants and lineage across multiple languages.
